name: ping-cwm-sol
description: Checks the reachability to an ip address from device. The output should be a success if the reachability of the ip provided in the input is 100% from the machine. Else the validation would send a failure response.

definition.name: ping-cwm-sol

data.template:
Value successRate (\d+)
Value pingErrMsg (\S+.*)

Start
  ^.*Success rate is ${successRate} percent.*
  ^.*% ${pingErrMsg}.* -> Record

expressions.message: Success rate for ping is not 100 percent.

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") }

stateDataFilter.output: ${ . += (.pingCommand = "ping " + .ping.address + (if (.ping.vrf and .ping.vrf != "") then " vrf " + .ping.vrf else "" end) + (if .ping.repeat then " repeat " + (.ping.repeat | tostring) else "" end) + (if .ping.timeout then " timeout " + (.ping.timeout | tostring) else "" end) + (if .ping.verbose then " verbose" else "" end))}

${ . += (.pingCommand = "ping " + "vrf " + .ping.vrf + " " + .ping.address + (if .ping.repeat then " repeat " + (.ping.repeat | tostring) else "" end) + (if .ping.timeout then " timeout " + (.ping.timeout | tostring) else "" end))}

dataConditions.name: success condition
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: failure condition
dataConditions.condition: ${ if (.rakutilExecutorData.status=="failed" and .rakutilExecutorData.stash != null) then true else false end}

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"error", message: (if .rakutilExecutorData.message then .rakutilExecutorData.message else "Ping check failed." end), stash: .rakutilExecutorData.nsoResponse}}

logs.message: Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

definition.description: Checks the reachability to an ip address from device. The output should be a success if the reachability of the ip provided in the input is 100% from the machine. Else the validation would send a failure response.

ping.title: Ping Test Parameters

vrf.title: VRF Name
vrf.description: Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) instance name for the ping test

repeat.title: Repeat Count
repeat.description: Number of ping packets to send (default varies by device type)

address.title: Target IP Address
address.description: The IP address to test connectivity to

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Timeout value in seconds for each ping packet

verbose.title: Verbose Output
verbose.description: Enable verbose output for detailed ping results

ping.description: Configuration for network connectivity ping test
